valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj u1, u2 : User |
    some a : Photo |
    some d : Day {
        User = u1 + u2
        Influencer = u2
        Photo = a
        Ad = a
        Day = d
        User <: follows = none->none
        User <: sees = u1->a
        User <: posts = u1->a
        User <: suggested = none->none

} for exactly 2 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj u1, u2 : User |
    some disj a, n : Photo |
    some d : Day {
        User = u1 + u2
        Influencer = u2
        Photo = a + n
        Ad = a
        Day = d
        User <: follows = u2->u1
        User <: sees = u1->a + u2->a
        User <: posts = u1->n + u2->a
        User <: suggested = u1->u2
        Photo <: date = a->d + n->d
    }
} for exactly 2 User, exactly 2 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj p0, p1, p2 : Person |
    some disj c1, c2, c3 : Course |
    some disj x1, x2, x3 : Project |
    some disj g1, g2, g3 : Grade {
        Person = p0 + p1 + p2
        Professor = p0 + p1
        Student = p1 + p2
        Course = c1 + c2 + c3
        Project = x1 + x2 + x3
        Grade = g1 + g2 + g3
        Person <: teaches = p0->c1 + p0->c2 + p1->c3
        Person <: enrolled = p1->c1 + p2->c2 + p2->c3
        Person <: projects = p1->x1 + p2->x2 + p2->x3
        Course <: projects = c1->x1 + c2->x2 + c3->x3
        Course <: grades = c1->p1->g1 + c2->p2->g2 + c3->p2->g3
        Grade <: next = g1->g2 + g2->g3
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 3 Course, exactly 3 Project, exactly 3 Grade expect 0
